rawContent: But at least so far the opposite seems to be happening. We keep finding new WAYS to be pissed off, with new movements like #MeToo and #MarchForOurLives addressing long-simmering problems brought to a boil by the current environment.
And the thing is, #MeToo and #MarchForOurLives shouldn't be strictly partisan, but they are seen as "liberal" because the people opposed to them are all conservative Republicans.
